basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all English-taught Master of Science programmes: Finance, Economics and Social Sciences, Data Science and Business Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, International Management, Cyber Risk Strategy & Governance, Transformative Sustainability, and Marketing Management.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 120 prestigious merit awards (Merit Awards & International Awards) awarded annually to top international applicants
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in economics, quantitative finance, and computer science compete actively (typically 3 to 7 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years (120 ECTS), contingent upon maintaining high academic GPA benchmarks in Year 1

nationality_requirements: Open to international non-Italian candidates holding an undergraduate degree from outside Italy
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with outstanding academic performance (equivalent to top 5% of class, minimum 3.80 / 4.00 CGPA or 85%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities like LUMS, IBA Karachi, NUST, FAST-NUCES, QAU).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalence to Italian 110/110 cum laude; first-class honors required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Strong quantitative, analytical, or computational foundation (calculus, linear algebra, statistics, microeconomics, or programming).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final year of Bachelor's degree graduating before October intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Financial/consulting internships, quantitative modeling, or tech research considered during evaluation.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (subscores 6.5+) or TOEFL iBT min 100 (subscores 22+) or Cambridge C1/C2.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Italian language not required for English-taught MSc programs; Italian crash courses provided free of charge.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite scholars in Finance, Economics, Data Science, and International Management.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with Italian Regional DSU scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Bocconi Graduate Merit Award provides a 100% full tuition waiver (€16,000/year; total 2-year value €32,000). The Bocconi International Award provides a 50% tuition reduction (€8,000/year).

admission_application_fee.details: Bocconi online application fee (€100) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: For full Graduate Merit Award recipients, free housing is provided in one of the Bocconi on-campus student residences in Milan (valued at ~€8,000 to €9,000/year).

monthly_stipend.details: Merit Award covers 100% tuition and accommodation; personal daily living and meals are self-funded by student (~€300 to €450/month).

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Milan are borne by the scholar.

visa_fee.details: Italian National Visa (Type D) application fee (€50) and Milan residence permit (Permesso di Soggiorno) fee (~€120).

health_insurance.details: Registration with the Italian National Health Service (SSN - Servizio Sanitario Nazionale, ~€700/year) paid by student.

food_allowance.details: Meals and personal expenses paid by student; heavily subsidized Bocconi student cafeteria available.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Bloomberg terminals, financial databases, and modern digital library resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Travel grants available through academic departments for presenting papers at international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Milan ATM urban monthly student transit pass (€22/month) paid by student.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (Bocconi University, Milan, Italy - Europe #1/2 in Business & Management, Global Top 10 in Finance)
participating_institutions: Bocconi University (Grafton Building, Roentgen Campus, Milan)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World Rank #7 in Business & Management, #16 in Economics & Econometrics, #1 in Italy; top feeder to Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley.
available_majors: Finance (Corporate Finance, Quantitative Finance, Asset Management)
Economics and Social Sciences (Theoretical & Empirical Economics)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with 3.8+ GPA, competitive GMAT (700+) or GRE (Quantitative 166+) or Bocconi Online Test, CV, personal statement, and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: MSc in Finance and International Management are among the most selective programs in Europe (average GMAT > 720); Data Science and Cyber Risk seek strong programmers with quantitative rigor.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: A strong GMAT (700+) or GRE score (Quantitative 166+) is the single most decisive factor for securing the Bocconi Graduate Merit Award. Apply in Round 1 or Round 2 (November or January) for maximum scholarship availability.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Bocconi My Application portal, create your candidate profile, select up to 5 Master of Science program preferences, and upload your dossier.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Prepare standardized test (GMAT, GRE, or register for the Bocconi Online Test).
Step 2: Create an account on the Bocconi My Application portal.
Step 3: Select program choices (up to 5 MSc programs ranked in order of preference).
Step 4: Upload official undergraduate transcripts, degree certificate, and grading scale.
Step 5: Upload your official GMAT/GRE score report and English proficiency certificate.
Step 6: Upload your academic CV and personal statement.
Step 7: Pay the €100 application fee and submit before the relevant admissions round deadline (Round 1: late Nov, Round 2: late Jan).
Step 8: The Admissions Committee automatically evaluates all admitted international applicants for Merit and International Awards.
Step 9: Admission and scholarship award notifications are released concurrently in the portal.
Step 10: Accept the offer, pay the tuition advance deposit (reimbursed upon matriculation for full merit scholars), and apply for Italian Type D visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: 100% automatic integration: no separate scholarship application required; all applicants with outstanding dossiers are automatically ranked for Merit Awards.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Optional for MSc admissions; referee contacts can be submitted in My Application portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Explain your academic motivation, career aspirations, and why Bocconi is the ideal launchpad for your professional goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for taught MSc programs.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1-page professional CV in standard business/finance format highlighting academic honours, test scores, internships, and quantitative competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews conducted for MSc admissions; selection is based on test scores and academic profile.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GMAT (700+ competitive) or GRE (Quantitative 166+ competitive) or Bocconi Online Test. IELTS Academic (7.0+) or TOEFL iBT (100+).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Declaration of Value (DOV) from the Italian Embassy in Islamabad or CIMEA Statement of Comparability required for Pakistani degrees prior to final matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Italian or English translations for all academic documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Bocconi My Application portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: Round 1: Late November; Round 2: Late January (Best rounds for scholarship consideration)
important_dates_timeline.university_admission_deadline: Round 1: late Nov; Round 2: late Jan; Round 3: early March
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Round 1 results: January; Round 2 results: March
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: May - July (Italian Type D student visa via Universitaly portal)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Multiple international admissions rounds; applying in Round 1 or Round 2 is critical because 80%+ of merit scholarships are awarded in the earliest rounds.

selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: 35% (GMAT / GRE / Bocconi test score is the primary ranking differentiator)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Bocconi Central Admissions Committee, chaired by the Dean of the Graduate School and program directors.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: The Admissions Committee calculates a composite ranking index where the GMAT/GRE score and undergraduate GPA account for ~75% of the evaluation. Top-ranked international candidates across each admissions round automatically receive Graduate Merit Awards (100% tuition + free housing) or International Awards (50% tuition reduction).

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~6,000 to 8,000 international applicants across all Master's programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 120 merit awards awarded across all MSc degrees
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% (LUMS and IBA graduates with 700+ GMAT have strong historical success)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.85+ / 4.00 CGPA (85%+ aggregate) combined with GMAT 710+ or GRE Quantitative 167+
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of premier business and engineering programs with top-tier test scores, internships at major financial institutions or multinationals, and strong quantitative foundations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, and Mathematics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Germany, France, Pakistan, India, China, USA, Italy, Turkey, Brazil.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agencies claiming they can secure Bocconi scholarships for commissions. Bocconi evaluates all candidates through official admissions rounds only.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Bocconi application fee is €100. No third-party fee is ever legitimate.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never pay consultants to draft your CV or personal statement; authentic personal career narratives are evaluated.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Milan has high living costs; personal living expenses and meals require €400 to €600/month.
Universitaly pre-enrollment and Italian Type D visa fees (~€170).
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Milan Malpensa (~PKR 180,000 - 260,000).
Mandatory Italian public health insurance (SSN) costs ~€700/year.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: High GPA alone is enough to get a scholarship. (FACT: A competitive GMAT/GRE score is mandatory for merit scholarship consideration).
CLAIM: You can apply for scholarships in late spring. (FACT: Merit scholarships are overwhelmingly exhausted after Round 2).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently confuse Bocconi Merit Awards (pure merit) with Italian Regional DSU (financial need) benefits.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Scholars must earn at least 50 credits by the end of the July exam session of Year 1 with a weighted GPA of at least 27/30 (Italian scale) to renew the scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance on the Milan campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual credit and grade point average check conducted by the Fees and Funding Office.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Non-EU students in Italy may work up to 20 hours per week (max 1,040 hours/year) under student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Italy grants a 12-month post-study residence permit extension (Permesso di Soggiorno per Ricerca Lavoro) for job seekers.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is revoked if the Year 1 GPA/credit threshold is not met; candidate is then responsible for Year 2 tuition fees.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the Graduate School Dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the 2-year duration of the Master of Science program.
